mike_ops: :rotating_light: Seeing ~5-8% connection resets + p95 spikes (10-100ms) between rack-3 and rack-4 for internal L4 LB. Started ~02:10 UTC. Affects GPU provisioning jobs and some live inference flows. anyone on call?
sara_net: I see increased retransmits on the fabric to leaf4, RDMA QP retries up on leaf-03 -> leaf-04. Noticing RNR and SND_NACKs in counters.
alex_sre: pulled LB logs — HAProxy backend for gpu-pool-b shows many conn resets and some DROPPED on the same ToR pair (leaf4 egress).
sara_net: quick tcpdump from spine1->leaf4 shows repeated SYNs and retransmits:
```
22:10:12.123456 IP leaf3 > leaf4: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
22:10:12.223654 IP leaf3 > leaf4: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
22:10:12.323789 IP leaf3 > leaf4: Flags [S], ack 0, win 64240, length 0
```
jordan_infra: checked ToR counters — eth1/49 on leaf4 shows egress queue 5 drops jumped by 1.5k in 10m. QoS tail drop on that queue.
alex_sre: config diff from last deploy shows we pushed a new QoS map to leaf4 during maintenance window 01:45-02:00. leaf3 kept old map (we didn't roll leaf3). Possible mismatch in DSCP->queue mapping.
kevin_eng: DSCP mismatch causing packets to be enqueued into a non-empty queue? That + ECN may cause early drops. Could be exacerbated if firmware handles RED/ECN differently.
nora_hw: hardware inventory — leaf4 is on firmware 2.3.1, neighbor leaf3 is 2.4.0. There was a vendor note about QoS/ECN interaction in 2.3.x. Opening a vendor ticket now.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4823 (internal-l4-tor-qos). Assigned to networking.
sara_net: immediate mitigation — shifting weight off gpu-pool-b backends on leaf4 to spare hosts in rack-2. I'll update LB weights now.
mike_ops: go for it. Also create a temporary traffic steering policy to avoid leaf4 for new provisioning jobs until we confirm.
kevin_eng: would it be quick to flip ECN off on leaf4 as a stopgap? That might reduce RED interactions. Risk: increased tail latency under sustained bursts.
jordan_infra: can do toggle but prefer to avoid unknown side-effects. I'll shift traffic and keep ECN toggle as Plan B if drops persist after reroute.
sara_net: reroute in progress — updating HAProxy backend weights, moving ~40 hosts to spare pool.
ora_hw: vendor ticket opened with logs and counter dumps, reference: VT-88112. They asked for firmware diff and QoS map; attaching now.
kevin_eng: thumbs up. once traffic is off leaf4 we should monitor retransmit and RDMA counters for 15m then decide full maintenance.
alex_sre: monitoring dashboards show retransmits down 90% after weight shift. p95 back to normal for the affected services.
mike_ops: great. Action items: 1) vendor ticket + firmware plan (nora_hw), 2) schedule coordinated maintenance to align QoS maps and upgrade leaf4 to 2.4.0 (jordan_infra), 3) postmortem if firmware is culprit (alex_sre).
infra-bot: Reminding on-call rotation: jordan_infra is on-call until 06:00 UTC.
mike_ops: will draft a short customer-facing note for internal stakeholders about provisioning delays this morning. Thanks team :thumbsup:
